prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Ready to launch your pet!", "Your pet is ready to leap onto your desktop. Click below to complete setup."]
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, drag, or interact on your desktop screen.", "Start Exploring"]
2: ["Customize Pet Personality", "Select traits to define how your pet behaves on your desktop.", "Playful, Calm, Energetic"]
3: ["Choose Your Desktop Journey", "Scroll through pet companion styles to find the path that suits your workspace best."]
4: ["Hatching Your Pet...", "Preparing animations, desktop behaviors, and sound effects.", "Building pet assets"]
5: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Pet", "Signing in secures your pet state across all your desktop devices.", "Cloud Save Active"]
6: ["Onboarding Complete!", "You have unlocked your official Desktop Explorer Badge.", "Explorer Badge Unlocked"]
7: ["Don't worry! You can edit your pet's name and details anytime from the tray menu."]
8: ["Select Your Adoption Method", "Compare pre-made quick pets against fully custom creation."]
9: ["Use your existing social or email login to reload existing pets automatically."]
